title: Middle of the Linked List
summary: Given the head of a singly linked list, identify and return the middle node.
statement: Given the head of a singly linked list, identify and return the middle node. If the list has an even number of nodes, return the second middle node.
constraints: The linked list contains 1 through 100 nodes.
Return the second middle node when the length is even, including the suffix beginning there.
reference_solution:
def middle_linked_list(head):
    slow=fast=head
    while fast and fast.next:slow=slow.next;fast=fast.next.next
    return slow
known_wrong_solutions:
def middle_linked_list(head):
    slow=fast=head
    while fast and fast.next.next:slow=slow.next;fast=fast.next.next
    return slow
def middle_linked_list(head):
    slow=fast=head
    while fast and fast.next:slow=slow.next.next;fast=fast.next.next
    return slow
hints: A pointer moving twice as fast covers the list while slow covers half.
Advance slow one node and fast two while two fast steps remain.
When fast reaches the end, return slow.
After each round slow has advanced half as many edges; even lengths therefore select the later middle.
editorial: After each round slow has advanced half as many edges; even lengths therefore select the later middle.

tests.explanation: Slow reaches value three when fast reaches the end, returning [3,4,5].
For even length the second middle is value four, returning [4,5,6].
